routes.approach: Import WattsFoundation.GeneratorTransportNaturality, WattsFoundation.GeneratorTransportAction, and Proofs.EilenbergWatts in the consumer workspace. The checked transport lemmas now supply the regular comparison, naturality, and action square. Install Projective P and Projective Q from the endpoint and apply SmallGeneratorBridge.equivalenceOfSmallProjectiveGenerator with the respective separator and discrete-colimit-preservation premises. Fix these IsEquivalence instances before introducing HP.asEquivalence and HQ.asEquivalence so the transported functor and the checked regular comparison use the same HP inverse. Transport along the source inverse and HQ by whiskering. Lift both directions to the reviewed Good using additivity and finite and Type v discrete colimit preservation, and lift the ambient unit and counit. Compose with the registered EilenbergWatts inverse at ring universe v and lift universe 0. Use its equality after forgetting the right action to obtain a natural module comparison with evaluation at the lifted regular. Compose this with evaluationTransportIso. Apply evaluationTransportIso_natural at the underlying θ of the reviewed full subcategory. For the action formula, reduce the EilenbergWatts conjugated right multiplication to regularRight and apply evaluationTransportIso_intertwines at MulOpposite.op p. The next small check is repacking a single Sigma bimodule along a symbolic left S-module isomorphism e from the transported carrier to the desired evaluation carrier. Keep the desired ModuleCat object and use e.toLinearEquiv.symm.toAddEquiv.module to pull back the right action from the transported carrier. Prove the two actions commute by left S-linearity of e and e.inv and the transported object's commuting-action field. Package the existing left module with its equality witness and the transferred right action. After that check, define the repacked forward map from the underlying linear map of HQ.map (θ.app P). Use comparison naturality and right linearity to verify that it respects the transferred right action. Lift the module comparisons to bimodule isomorphisms and use changeFunctor. Choose the strict evaluation equality using the repacked objects and maps, with ModuleCat.ofHom_hom for the rebundled maps. Compute the reviewed cast formulas using that equality. The left action is precomposition by q, the right action square gives b ≫ F.obj.map (End.asHom p), and the morphism is b ≫ θ.app P. The exact bimodule packaging and the final correspondence proposition still need a consumer compile and axiom audit. The plan retains ProjectiveGeneratorModuleReconstruction pending the engine's owner decision on that planned edge after an exact article proof receipt. The existing portal hold concerns choice-free inverse families.
